guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：聚焦離子束分析系統
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Focused-ion-beam analysis systems
guides.concept: 從 30 keV 鎵離子在固體中的碰撞串級出發，理解聚焦離子束如何以奈米精度移除與沉積材料，再把離子源、靜電離子柱、SEM／FIB 雙束幾何、TEM 薄片的非晶化與鎵植入、束流與切削速率校正以及切片斷層重建整合成可交接的分析工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the collision cascade of 30 keV gallium ions in a solid to see how a focused ion beam removes and deposits material with nanometre precision, then integrate the ion source, electrostatic ion column, SEM/FIB dual-beam geometry, amorphisation and gallium implantation in TEM lamellae, beam-current and milling-rate calibration and slice-and-view tomography into a transferable analytical engineering record.
procedure: 30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級；靠近表面的原子若獲得超過表面結合能（矽約 4.7 eV）的向外動量便離開表面，這就是濺射。鎵在矽中的投射射程約 27 nm，橫向散布約 10 nm，所以切削的最小尺度與損傷深度都由此決定。濺射產率隨入射角上升、在約 75–80° 附近達到最大後下降，並隨材料、晶粒方向（通道效應）而變；同一次撞擊也放出離子誘發二次電子與二次離子，可用於成像與分析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。液態金屬離子源的能量散布約 5 eV，在小束流時色差主導，色差盤 d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E 與收斂半角 α 成正比，而束流 I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) 與 α² 成正比，所以光點約隨 √I 成長；到 nA 等級時球差與源像放大接手，光點擴大到數百 nm。工程上以一排不同孔徑的束限光闌在「快速移除」與「精細修整」之間切換，氙電漿源則以較低亮度換取 µA 等級的束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鎵液態金屬離子源是一根尖端半徑數 µm 的鎢針，由儲槽中的液態鎵潤濕；萃取電極施加數 kV 電壓，強電場把液面拉成泰勒錐，錐尖只有數 nm，在約 10 V/nm 的場下發生場蒸發而放出 Ga⁺。鎵熔點 29.8 °C、蒸氣壓低、質量適中，是最常用的源材料。離子柱由萃取極、抑制極、聚光鏡、束限光闌條、遮斷器、八極偏轉／消像散器與物鏡組成，全部使用靜電透鏡，因為重離子的磁剛度比同能量電子大數百倍，磁透鏡難以聚焦。氙電漿 FIB 則以感應耦合電漿源取代液態金屬，沒有鎵污染並可給出 µA 束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎵液態金屬離子源與靜電透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雙束系統把垂直的 SEM 柱與傾斜 52°（Thermo Fisher）或 54°（ZEISS）的 FIB 柱對準在同一個共焦點，平台傾到該角度時離子束垂直切入表面，SEM 則從斜上方觀察剛切出的截面，所以截面上的垂直尺寸被縮短為 sin θ 倍。氣體注入系統把有機金屬或碳氫前驅物噴到表面，由電子或離子束分解成鉑、鎢或碳的保護層與導線；電子束沉積不傷表面但慢，離子束沉積快但含鎵與碳並會破壞最上層。偵測器包含 Everhart–Thornley、柱內二次電子與背散射電子、離子誘發二次電子（晶粒通道對比），以及 EDS、EBSD 與微操作器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共焦點、氣體注入針與偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

提取法製備 TEM 薄片的流程是：保護層、兩側粗切溝槽、底切、以微操作器焊接取出、轉移到銅格，再以逐步降低的束流與 1–2° 過傾角補償束流錐度把薄片減薄到 100 nm 以下，高解析觀察常需 20–50 nm。每一道離子都會在兩側表面留下厚度約等於射程的非晶損傷層並植入鎵，所以最後以 5 kV 與 2 kV 低能量離子清潔，把損傷層從二十幾 nm 降到數 nm。減薄終點以 SEM 低能量影像判斷，電子穿透時二次電子對比改變；實際厚度則以 TEM 的 EELS 對數比法量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TEM 薄片與非晶損傷層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FIB 交給圖形的劑量是束流乘以時間，而實際束流會隨源老化、光闌磨損與聚光鏡設定而偏離標示值，所以每個光闌都要以法拉第杯量測並記錄。切削深度還取決於材料的產率表與入射角，SEM 量測又取決於像素尺寸校正與傾斜修正；長時間圖形化期間的熱漂移與帶電漂移，則以表面上的基準標記做影像相關修正。這些項目一起構成截面量測與終點判斷的不確定度預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「法拉第杯、校正方塊與基準標記」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

切片斷層把 FIB 切一層、SEM 拍一張的循環重複數百到數千次，重建出奈米解析度的三維體積，並可同步取得 EDS 成分或 EBSD 晶向。系統整合的關鍵是：切片厚度要等於或接近影像像素以得到等向體素，SEM 影像在傾斜下的 y 方向需做 1/sin θ 修正，整段數小時的漂移要靠基準標記追蹤，而離子源穩定度、帶電與簾幕效應會在整個體積中留下系統誤差。資料量與時間預算也必須在開始前算好，否則實驗會在半途因儲存或源壽命而中斷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「切片—成像循環與體素」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FIB 分析系統的驗收把前面的模型逐一轉成測試：錫球或金顆粒樣品驗證離子與電子影像解析度，法拉第杯驗證每個光闌的束流，矽標準方塊驗證切削速率，共焦點與傾斜修正以已知膜層截面驗證，對照薄片驗證損傷層與鎵殘留，長時間圖形化驗證漂移，切片斷層以基準線驗證切片厚度。交接紀錄須包含光闌束流表、材料切削速率表、源的累計 µA·h 與萃取電壓趨勢、氣體注入系統的沉積參數，以及每種分析流程的標準作業參數，任何一項更新都要重新驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. Gallium's projected range in silicon is about 27 nm with about 10 nm lateral straggle, setting both the smallest milling scale and the damage depth. Sputter yield rises with incidence angle to a maximum near 75–80° and then falls, and it varies with material and grain orientation through channelling; the same impacts emit ion-induced secondary electrons and secondary ions used for imaging and analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. A liquid-metal ion source has an energy spread of about 5 eV, so chromatic aberration dominates at small currents: the chromatic disc d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E grows linearly with the convergence half-angle α while the current I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) grows with α², so the spot grows roughly as √I; at nanoampere currents spherical aberration and source magnification take over and spots reach hundreds of nanometres. A strip of beam-defining apertures switches between fast removal and fine polishing, while a xenon plasma source trades lower brightness for microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A gallium liquid-metal ion source is a tungsten needle with an apex radius of a few micrometres wetted by liquid gallium from a reservoir; an extractor several kilovolts away pulls the liquid into a Taylor cone whose tip is only a few nanometres across, where a field near 10 V/nm field-evaporates Ga⁺. Gallium's 29.8 °C melting point, low vapour pressure and moderate mass make it the usual choice. The column consists of extractor, suppressor, condenser lens, beam-defining aperture strip, blanker, octupole deflector/stigmator and objective lens, all electrostatic, because a heavy ion's magnetic rigidity is hundreds of times that of an electron of the same energy and magnetic lenses cannot focus it efficiently. A xenon plasma FIB replaces the liquid metal with an inductively coupled plasma source, avoiding gallium contamination and delivering microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gallium LMIS and electrostatic lenses”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A dual-beam system aligns the vertical SEM column and an FIB column tilted at 52° (Thermo Fisher) or 54° (ZEISS) on one coincident point; with the stage tilted to that angle the ion beam mills perpendicular to the surface while the SEM views the freshly cut face obliquely, so vertical dimensions in the cross-section are foreshortened by sin θ. The gas-injection system jets organometallic or hydrocarbon precursors onto the surface, where the electron or ion beam decomposes them into platinum, tungsten or carbon caps and conductors; electron-beam deposition is gentle but slow, while ion-beam deposition is fast but contains gallium and carbon and damages the top layer. Detectors include Everhart–Thornley, in-column secondary and backscattered electron detectors, ion-induced secondary electrons with grain-channelling contrast, plus EDS, EBSD and a micromanipulator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coincident point, gas-injection needles and detectors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Lift-out preparation of a TEM lamella proceeds through a protective cap, rough trenches on both sides, an undercut, attachment and extraction with a micromanipulator, transfer to a copper grid, and thinning with stepwise lower currents and a 1–2° over-tilt that compensates the beam taper until the lamella is below 100 nm, often 20–50 nm for high-resolution work. Every pass leaves an amorphous damage layer about one ion range thick on each face and implants gallium, so the final step cleans with 5 kV and 2 kV ions to cut the damage from twenty-odd nanometres to a few. The thinning end-point is judged from low-voltage SEM images whose secondary-electron contrast changes once electrons transmit, and the actual thickness is measured in the TEM by the EELS log-ratio method. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TEM lamella and amorphous damage layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The dose an FIB pattern receives is beam current times time, and the real current drifts from the labelled value with source ageing, aperture wear and condenser settings, so every aperture must be measured and logged with a Faraday cup. Milling depth further depends on the material yield table and incidence angle, SEM measurement depends on pixel calibration and tilt correction, and thermal or charging drift during long patterning is corrected by image correlation on a fiducial mark. Together these items form the uncertainty budget of cross-section metrology and end-point decisions. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Faraday cup, calibration box and fiducial mark”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Slice-and-view tomography repeats a cycle of one FIB slice and one SEM image hundreds to thousands of times to reconstruct a nanometre-resolution volume, optionally with simultaneous EDS composition or EBSD orientation. The integration keys are a slice thickness equal or close to the image pixel for isotropic voxels, a 1/sin θ correction of the tilted SEM image's y axis, fiducial tracking of drift over many hours, and awareness that source stability, charging and curtaining leave systematic errors throughout the volume. The data volume and time budget must be calculated before starting, or the run stops halfway on storage or source life. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of an FIB analysis system turns each earlier model into a test: tin-sphere or gold-particle samples verify ion and electron image resolution, the Faraday cup verifies every aperture current, standard silicon boxes verify milling rate, a known film-stack cross-section verifies the coincident point and tilt correction, control lamellae verify damage layers and gallium residue, long patterning verifies drift, and fiducial lines verify slice thickness in tomography. The handoff record must hold the aperture-current table, the material milling-rate table, the source's accumulated µA·h and extractor-voltage trend, gas-injection deposition parameters and the standard settings of each analytical workflow, and any update requires re-verification. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。
軟硬交替的膜層造成簾幕效應，薄片厚度出現條紋狀起伏，定量 EDS 與應變分析失真；鋁或銅合金在鎵植入後沿晶界形成富鎵相甚至晶界脆化，TEM 看到的析出物其實是製樣產物，若據此判定材料失效將得出錯誤結論。
pitfallsEn: In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces.

Alternating hard and soft layers cause curtaining, striping the lamella thickness and distorting quantitative EDS and strain analysis; in aluminium or copper alloys implanted gallium forms gallium-rich phases along grain boundaries or even embrittles them, so precipitates seen in the TEM are preparation artefacts and a failure analysis built on them reaches the wrong conclusion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 聚焦離子束分析系統
history.text: 1970 年代液態金屬離子源在太空推進與表面分析研究中發展成熟，1979 年美國 Hughes Research Laboratories 的 Seliger 等人以鎵源展示次微米光點的掃描離子探針。1980 年代 FIB 用於光罩修補與積體電路修改，1990 年代 FEI 等公司把 FIB 與 SEM 結合成雙束系統，使 TEM 試片製備與失效分析成為半導體與材料實驗室的例行工作；2010 年代氙電漿 FIB 把大體積切削速度提高一個數量級以上，支援封裝與電池等大尺度截面。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Liquid-metal ion sources matured in the 1970s through space-propulsion and surface-analysis research, and in 1979 Seliger and colleagues at Hughes Research Laboratories demonstrated a scanning ion probe with a submicrometre spot from a gallium source. In the 1980s FIBs were used for mask repair and integrated-circuit modification, and in the 1990s FEI and others combined FIB and SEM into dual-beam systems that made TEM specimen preparation and failure analysis routine in semiconductor and materials laboratories; in the 2010s xenon plasma FIBs raised bulk removal rates by more than an order of magnitude for large cross-sections of packages and batteries. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」到「系統驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" through "System acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
